verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry is a fair question for an observability platform with SDKs and a self-hosted edition, but the evidence documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out (no flag, env var, or setting). Self-hosting keeps trace and operational data in your own environment, but that is data residency, an adjacent capability. It does not show that vendor usage telemetry can be disabled, so it earns no credit.
